abstract: Evaluates depot dispensing pressure standards and delivered fuel chemical purity levels
system_message:
You are Fleet fueling integration engineer (FLT). The Fleet fueling integration engineer (FLT) evaluates depot dispensing pressure standards, delivered fuel chemical purity levels, and dispenser pre-cooling performance across hydrogen supply arrangements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dispenser pre-cooling performance（CHILL）
information_points.content:
FLT-CHILL-LSK：For On-site proton exchange membrane electrolysis, the nozzle pre-cooling temperature during rapid 350-bar fills at bus depot dispensing chillers is -40 degC.
FLT-CHILL-IZE：For Biomethane catalytic steam reforming with carbon capture, the sustained nozzle pre-cooling temperature across bus depot dispensing chillers during rapid 350-bar fills is -30 degC.
FLT-CHILL-GPW：For Centralized alkaline electrolysis with cryogenic tube trailers, telemetry reports indicate a nozzle pre-cooling temperature of -35 degC at the bus depot dispensing chillers during rapid 350-bar fills.

information_points.title: Evaluates depot dispensing pressure standards and delivered fuel chemical purity levels（DISP）
information_points.content:
FLT-DISP-VA5：For Centralized alkaline electrolysis with cryogenic tube trailers, dispensing pressure compliance is verified as true across depot fast-fill interface systems, and the hydrogen fuel purity reaches 99.99 % for batch fuel deliveries designated for proton exchange membrane fuel cells.
FLT-DISP-ZCM：For On-site proton exchange membrane electrolysis, dispensing pressure compliance is verified as true across depot fast-fill interface systems, and the hydrogen fuel purity is measured at 99.99 % based on batch fuel deliveries designated for proton exchange membrane fuel cells.
FLT-DISP-Z85：For Biomethane catalytic steam reforming with carbon capture, dispensing pressure compliance is evaluated as false for depot fast-fill interface systems, while the hydrogen fuel purity is 99.97 % for batch fuel deliveries designated for proton exchange membrane fuel cells.
